title: Pan-Seared Chicken Liver with Ayurvedic Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken liver dish, marinated in a blend of traditional ayurvedic spices and pan-seared to perfection. This recipe is a great way to enjoy liver, rich in iron and nutrients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together ayurvedic spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Add chicken liver to the bowl and mix well to coat.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the marinated chicken liver to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken liver from the skillet and let it rest for a few minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
